item.title: 🔴 One intrusion, two cyberattackers: Uncovering parallel threat activity
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.

Ransomware case reveals two parallel threat actors, blending tactics and evasion—showing why isolated signals can often miss modern, overlapping cyberattacks.
